issues.title: Killing of former anti-graft prosecutor a grim milestone in Guatemala's political violence
issues.title_en: Killing of former anti-graft prosecutor a grim milestone in Guatemala's political violence
issues.summary: GUATEMALA CITY, Oct 19 - The assassination at the weekend of anti-graft lawyer Juan Francisco Solorzano Foppa, who made powerful enemies by taking on Guatemala's elite, marks one of the most significant political killings in the country in recent decades, renewing concerns about the vulnerability of those who fight corruption in Central America. Read more at straitstimes.com.
